name: grid-page
title: Browse Grid
description: Browse a set of peer items in a responsive grid; any one opens into its own full detail page.

files.components/detail.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# THE OPEN ITEM: one item, full width, in its own detail arrangement. The item arrives
# with the result it references, so nothing about it is ever written.
type: component
name: detail
category: Content
nodeSize:
  width: 960
  height: 900
props:
  item:
    type: array
    input: true
    description: >-
      The one item shown in full, picked by its ref from what the search found.
    minItems: 1
    maxItems: 1
    preview:
      - title: Lightsaber Combat Training
        description: Master the seven forms of lightsaber combat with guidance from Jedi Masters.
        image: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1761403583/gravity/YodaPark/darth-vader-main_4560aff7.jpg
        link: "[BEGIN TRAINING](https://example.com)"
    items:
      title:
        type: string
        description: The item's own name, exactly as it is published. Comes from the referenced result.
        hydrate: title
        override: false
      description:
        type: string
        description: What the item is, in its own published words. Comes from the referenced result.
        hydrate: body
        override: false
      image:
        type: string
        description: The item's own picture, drawn from the referenced result. Never authored.
        hydrate: image
      link:
        type: string
        description: The way into this item, drawn from the referenced result. Never authored.
        hydrate: link
root:
  type: Each
  bind:
    items: item
  style:
    direction: column
    width: full
  item:
    type: Box
    style:
      width: full
      direction: column
      gap: "6"
      textAlign: start
    children:
      - type: Ref
        ref: cover-image
        visibleWhen: image
        props:
          src: image
          alt: title
        style:
          height: "100"
      - type: Box
        style:
          direction: column
          gap: "4"
          padding: [ "0", "6", "6", "6" ]
          width: full
          maxWidth: reading
          align: start
        children:
          - type: Text
            bind:
              value: title
            style:
              font: headline.lg
              weight: bold
              color: text.primary
              lineHeight: tight
          - type: Text
            visibleWhen: description
            bind:
              value: description
            style:
              font: body.lg
              color: text.secondary
          - type: Ref
            ref: cta-link
            visibleWhen: link
            props:
              link: link

        description: What the item is, in its own published words. Comes from the referenced result.
        hydrate: body
        override: false

files.grid-page.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# THE FIRST SHELF TEMPLATE (docs/unoverse/design/models/UNOVERSE_TEMPLATE_MODEL.md §9b).
# TWO STATES, one template: browse and detail are the same template's life, `grid` and
# `page`, the standard names. Each layout places one part: the tiles the Agent picked in
# `grid`, one item in full in `page`. A universal thing carries no context, so every
# word on the page comes from the results the Agent picked.
type: template
name: grid-page
states:
  grid:
    layout: layouts/grid
  page:
    layout: layouts/page
files.layouts/grid.yaml:
# The BROWSE arrangement: the tiles part, a RESPONSIVE grid whose column count is set per
# breakpoint band inside the part (stacked on mobile, two across on tablet, three on
# desktop, four at full). The OUTER box is the measuring context (`container`): the bands
# read the width this arrangement actually has, wherever it is placed, so a grid in a
# narrow rail stacks on a wide screen.
type: Box
style:
  width: full
  container: inline-size
children:
  - type: Box
    style:
      width: full
      # The browse arrangement's own top breathing room — the mount frame
      # deliberately carries no top padding (it would break the page state's
      # sticky header).
      padding: [ "4", "0", "0", "0" ]
    children:
      - type: Ref
        ref: components/tiles
files.layouts/page.yaml:
# The DETAIL arrangement (`page` state): one item, full width.
type: Box
style:
  direction: column
  width: full
children:
  - type: Ref
    ref: components/detail
